summary.text: Horace Taylor is an independent candidate for Tennessee's 8th District and an information technology professional who served in the U.S. Army from 1981 to 2012, according to his Ballotpedia profile.
He says he would evaluate votes on whether they move things forward for West Tennesseans.

paragraphs.text: Taylor graduated from Southside High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Memphis in 1993, according to Ballotpedia.
He later received a graduate degree from the University of Maryland University College in 2005.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1981 to 2012 and works as an information technology professional.
Taylor lists cost of living, rural healthcare access, agricultural and trade policy, rural broadband, cybersecurity, education and public safety as his policy interests.
